name: Shiori
message: "School should be over by now, but there are still hardly any kids in this park."

name: Shiori
message: "There's another park nearby with lots of playground equipment. That one's usually packed."

name: Shiori
message: "I always felt uneasy bringing a small child to such a crowded place, so I brought my sister here instead."

name: Shiori
message: "This place was closer to home, too. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "It's always when we're just chatting casually that a memory comes back to me."

name: Shiori
message: "But when I actually try to remember something, nothing comes back. Strange, isn’t it?"

name: Shiori
message: "We should head somewhere else for now, so we can come back later and make it look like a coincidence."

name: Shiori
message: "No good. I'm being way too conscious of it right now. I'm basically just sitting here waiting for my memories to come back. Something like, 'memories, to me!'"

name: Shiori
message: "We're just wasting time here... Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmmm..."

name: Shiori
message: "A sharp-gazed older man... Looks like he's not here yet."

name: Shiori
message: "What now? Do you want to wander around a little longer to kill some time? Or should we just wait here?"
(Go somewhere else)
(Wait)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, got it. Let's go then."
(Grand Park)
(Convenience Store)
(Library)
(Parking Lot)
(Supermarket)
(Housing Complex)
(Flower Garden)
(Apartment Building)
(Shrine)
(Alleyway)
(Payphone)
(Housing Complex)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's wait on that bench, then."
(Sit on the bench)

name: Shiori
message: "There we go... Phew..."

name: Shiori
message: "Asking questions is one thing, but... how am I even supposed to start the conversation? I can't just walk up and ask him if he's the culprit."

name: Shiori
message: "...But if—just what if—the culprit really was the sharp-gazed man... in a place like this, he could probably kidnap someone without anyone noticing."

name: Shiori
message: "It's always so quiet here. Even now, there's no one around but us."

name: Shiori
message: "But... hmm... Ms. Librarian said the victims were preschool age, right? Children under six..."

name: Shiori
message: "Would children that small really be playing alone in a park?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well... hmm... I guess it isn't impossible. This area is supposed to be safe, after all..."

name: Shiori
message: "But in our household, we never left my little sister by herself. Someone always went with her whenever she played outside. Always."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... right. Ehehe, I just remembered. My little sister didn't really like playing outside."

name: Shiori
message: "And neither did I. We liked watching anime and movies together."

name: Shiori
message: "I know it sounds odd coming from me, but... the way I talk is a little unusual, don't you think?"

name: Shiori
message: "She'd always get so happy when I got theatrical."

name: Shiori
message: "We used to play pretend. I'd act like a character from a story, talking with big exaggerated gestures..."

name: Shiori
message: "My sister would play along, too. For her age, she had a surprisingly large vocabulary. She started talking early, and was a really smart kid."

name: Shiori
message: "Like me, she was such a chatterbox. Ehehe, the complete opposite of you."

name: Shiori
message: "...I wish I could talk normally in front of you."

name: Shiori
message: "But... I don't really know what my 'normal' self is anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "It's not like I always talked this way to my sister. And with my dad, my mom, and my friends, I spoke normally."

name: Shiori
message: "I remember that much. But... I can't remember *how* I used to talk."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't even remember anyone's face. Not my little sister's, not even her voice... I don't know any of it."

name: Shiori
message: "They're supposed to be the most important parts, the very first things I should be remembering, and yet..."

name: Shiori
message: "...No. Maybe that's precisely why I've lost 'myself,' since I'm missing the most important things."

name: Shiori
message: "...Ehehe, now I'm being unusually sentimental."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you, for always listening so quietly."

name: Shiori
message: "That's what I love about you."

name: Shiori
message: "The sun's starting to set..."

name: Shiori
message: "If we wait a little longer and he still doesn't show up, we should call it a day."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's come back tomorrow—"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that didn't work. I figured he'd come if I built some suspense."

name: Shiori
message: "It's a shame, but we should head back—"

name: Shiori
message: "Wait, he really did show up this time."

name: Shiori
message: "A sharp-gazed... older man?"

name: Shiori
message: "He's a lot younger than I expected. Definitely not old. Thirties, maybe? I imagined someone... dandier."

name: Shiori
message: "But he is sharp-gazed. And kind of ghostly, too. It must be him."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll try talking to him. You wait here, okay? If he turns out to be dangerous, it'd be... well, dangerous."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I know that sounded redundant, like saying a headache's making my head ache. Just pretend you didn't hear it. Anyway, I'm going now."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, excuse me—"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry to bother you all of a sudden. Do you have a moment?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "...So that's why you called out to me."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You're too old. I prefer someone younger."
Shiori-san is looking at me with an expression I can't even describe.
I should probably go over to her...

name: Suspicious Man
message: "...Who are you two, anyway? I'm leaving."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, um, we won't take much of your time—"

name: Shiori
message: "There's something we want to ask you. Um... it seems I died here after getting caught up in some kind of incident."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You're... dead?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Aren't you, too?"

name: Shiori
message: "Do you come here often? I was wondering if you might know anything about the incident..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You don't have your memories either?"

name: Shiori
message: "...You too?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "I haven't forgotten everything. I know I'm dead. I just don't know why or how."

name: Shiori
message: "I see. I'm... in a similar situation..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "I've seen your face before."

name: Shiori
message: "What?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "What's your name?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, um... My name is Kugayama. Kugayama, Shiori..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama... Shiori..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama... Kugayama?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama, Shiori?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Do you... know me?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama Shiori..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama... SHIORI!!!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Kugayama Shiori! It's you! You, you, you, YOU!"

name: Shiori
message: "P-Please calm down. Do you... know me?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Do I know you?! DO I KNOW YOU?! STOP PLAYING DUMB!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "I remember! I remember now! I remember everything!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You! It was YOU!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You let me die! YOU killed me!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "That's right, oh that's right, that's right! Because of you, I...!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "It's all your fault! You ruined everything!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Wh-Wha... What did I... do to you?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Oh don't you dare play dumb! Not after you pinned everything on me!"

name: Shiori
message: "Pinned...?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You told them I kidnapped those kids, that I killed them! It's all your fault! Do you even know how badly they hounded me?!"

name: Shiori
message: "Because of... me? Wait, hold on—weren't you the culprit—"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP! It wasn't me! It wasn't me, it wasn't me!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "YOU'RE the real criminal here! Not me!"

name: Shiori
message: "Wha... ah, huh...?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "YOU did it! You killed me, and all those kids!"

name: Shiori
message: "But that... can't be... I... my sister... I mean, you... my sister..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Haha! Your sister, you say?! That's right! Your sister died because of YOU!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You killed her just like the rest of them!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "It was you! You killed us!"

name: Shiori
message: "I... killed... my sister...?"
"Lies."
"He's wrong."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Then why the hell am I dead?! Explain that!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "If it weren't for you, I'd still be alive right now!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "It's all your fault, Kugayama Shiori!"
"Don't believe him."
"He's completely wrong."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "How dare you show your face to me!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Why are you still here?! Why aren't you in hell?!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "Damn you! DAMN YOU!!"
"That's enough."
"Let's go."

name: Shiori
message: "Eh, ah..."

name: Suspicious Man
message: "I won't forgive you!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "I'll never forgive you! Never, NEVER!"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "KUGAYAMA SHIORI!"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. It's gotten completely dark, hasn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah, I'm okay... I've... calmed down a little... Yeah, just a little."

name: Shiori
message: "About what he said..."
"You don't have to believe him."
"It was all nonsense."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be nice... if that were true..."

name: Shiori
message: "But I don't know him. I don't remember him at all."

name: Shiori
message: "And yet... he knew who I was."

name: Shiori
message: "All the memories I had of him... they're completely gone from inside me."

name: Shiori
message: "So I... I can't say for sure... that he was wrong..."

name: Shiori
message: "He was a victim... Girl A was the real culprit..."

name: Shiori
message: "And Girl A... was me...?"

name: Shiori
message: "My sister... if I could just see my sister... If I could just..."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't even know if the timing is good or bad... I've been looking for her this whole time... but right now... I'm too scared to talk to her..."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey... can you come with me?"
"Yes."

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go... before she disappears again."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, um..."

name: Shiori
message: "You were watching us before, weren't you?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Do you... know who I am?"
She doesn't answer.
...? Something's off...

name: Shiori
message: "Could you be... my—"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"
The little ghost girl is gone.

name: Shiori
message: "She... rejected me...?"

name: Shiori
message: "I-I... did that... to my sister...?"
"No."
"Calm down."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't know... I just... I don't understand myself anymore..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I'm sorry for keeping you out so late."

name: Shiori
message: "You should... go home. As for me..."

name: Shiori
message: "I need... a little time alone... to think..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you for today."

name: Shiori
message: "Goodbye."
I should record what happened today on my phone.
Shiori-san is gone.
Time to head home.
